scientific_question: Does the C3 recipe (wide15 anti-aliased corpus, CE 1 + Dice 1 + M7-KL 0.5 with the shipped flag triple, SGD 1e-3 poly, no trust region) keep or improve its frozen-harness lead when the declared 250k poly schedule is actually run to completion, i.e. once the learning rate anneals? Every wide arm so far was stopped at 50k, where the LR is still 0.82x and milestone macro is a random walk (B0-vs-B0r matched-milestone RMS 0.0357).

why_c3.frontier_fixed18_pherc1447_jackpot_ref: At similar, not identical, foreground: C3@30k T=0.35 (fg 0.697x, bridges 5,011, line-cov 0.758, comps 151) improves these reference-relative measures over H_c3_human25@15k T=0.25 (fg 0.682x, 5,854, 0.730, 238). C3 is the preferred observed tradeoff; these confounded, finite pilots do not prove that no future recipe can shift the frontier. The reference is a model exemplar, not ground truth.
why_c3.ball_lane_excluded: The operator excludes every 8x-ball 250k run. The constrained pilots supply no compelling reason to choose that lane. Projection activity is not proof that further learning is impossible; human25 was projected on 76.56% of updates in its first 5k interval, then 100% in the next two.

decision_rules.tie_margin: B0/B0r 0.0715 is a descriptive historical variability band, NOT a C3 confidence interval or permission to automatically replace C3 with a worse checkpoint. No C3r run is required or launched.
decision_rules.gate: Eligible iff fixed-T=.35 six-cube foreground ratio <=1.25, each cube interior delta <=.10 and max-thickness delta <=2, and fixed-T=.35 frozen-val Dice gain versus released M7 is >=0 on both PHerc0814 and PHerc1451. The .75 foreground lower bound is advisory for this soft arm. Calibrated-T and .25 gates are diagnostic only.
decision_rules.annealed_half_hypothesis: H1: best eligible fixed-T=.35 macro at >=150k is >= best eligible at <=50k. Proposed candidate is best eligible fixed-T=.35 macro at >=150k, ties to later milestone. Always report the exact 250k checkpoint, global best, best early, and original C3@30k beside it. No eligible late checkpoint means no proposed replacement, not silent fallback.
decision_rules.duration_verdict: Report the candidate's fixed-T=.35 delta against C3@30k (.6768526715), and H1 separately. A result within the historical .0715 variability band is unresolved, not proven equivalent. Retain every checkpoint and stop for operator review; do not automatically deploy or discard the original C3.
decision_rules.ship_vs_baselines: Advisory readiness check at fixed T=.35: v14p2 Kaggle >=.6212 and TopoScore >=.3776. Explicitly label student no-TTA versus M7+TTA as a stronger deployment baseline, not an identical inference comparison. Calibrated/.45 scores remain diagnostic. PHerc0500P2 absolute only; no automatic deployment.
decision_rules.frontier_veto: At candidate T=.35, compare bridge pixels with C3 interpolated to the candidate's fixed18 reference-line coverage on the recorded [.25,.30,.35,.40] curve. More than +20% is a review veto; no extrapolation outside the measured coverage overlap (report unresolved). This never tunes the operating threshold or selects a checkpoint from PHerc1447.
decision_rules.operating_threshold: Fixed 0.35 by operator choice. Never replace it with calibrated T or tune it on PHerc1447. T=.25 is reported for continuity and cannot veto this run.
decision_rules.seed_uncertainty: One C3 seed and correlated checkpoints cannot establish superiority beyond seed noise. Any future seed experiment requires separate authorization.

interruption_policy.crash: Strict --resume of the same sealed run; at most 3 training launches total, persisted across coordinator restarts. Never resume old C3, relax identity, or restart fresh over an existing run. Stop for review on exhausted retries or changed inputs/code.
interruption_policy.divergence_stop: REMOVED. No score-based interruption. Frozen audits run after training; below-.5926 comparisons are retrospective alerts only and are explicitly no-TTA student versus M7+TTA.
interruption_policy.no_early_stop_on_peaks: Complete all 250000 exposures and final validation/last-checkpoint commit naturally. Never kill on the 250k milestone. Nonfinite loss, process failure, or resource/identity failure are technical failures, not score-based selection.
